system.description:
A masked shinobi stalks a group of spies. The spies get pretty far into the country before they settle in for a rest. While resting the spies sense that something is off before they attempt to perform evasive maneuvers. Ice erupts from the ground creating ground spikes, skewing a few of the intruding spies. It doesn’t take long before the masked shinobi confronts the panicking group. “You have wronged the village hidden in the Mist. You have stolen more than a fair share of village secrets and by order of lady Mizukage, you have been sentenced to death.” The words come out cold, and unfeeling. Sharp and dry at the same time. The shinobi realizes the risk in dealing with a Member of the Yuki Clan, but they know that if they do nothing, it’s already over. So, they draw their weapons and move in to confront this foe. The Yuki behind the mask smirks before all falls below subzero in the immediate area.

—Tatsunami Aburame, The Long Road, Ch. 16 excerpt.

Cold to the Bone

The Yuki Clan is a family of shinobi found in the Land of Water. They were almost wiped out due to a massive Kekkei Genkai revolt held in the country. Many died, and because of this their bloodline splintered. They no longer share a common family name, and are generally known as a family that in combat are nigh unbeatable.

Yuki Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Dex or Int, +1 Int or Cha (Int cannot be chosen as the +1 ASI, if it was chosen for the +2 ASI.)

Speed: 30 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Chakra Control, Stealth

Ice Release Affinity: You begin with either Wind or Water Release Affinity. (Pick one)

Ice Release Techniques: The Yuki Clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s).

Hijutsu Flexibility: Yuki Clan Hijutsu can use either Dexterity or Intelligence as its casting ability score.

Cold Adjustment: Yuki Clansmen are immune to hostile cold environments and do not need to make checks or saving throws to resist effects caused by extreme cold temperatures.

Slick Movement: Yuki Clansmen ignores difficult terrain and effects that would impede movement caused by jutsu with the Wind or Water Release keywords.

Yuki Features

The Looking Glass

1st Level Clan Feature

You are capable of manipulating water and wind release chakra, and fusing them together to create mirror like glass constructs that reflect you, and only you within them. As a Bonus action, you can select an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet of you that is along the ground. Within this space, you conjure a mirror pane that is 6 feet tall, 3 feet wide, and 2 inches thick. This mirror projects only your reflection and is known as your Ice Mirrors.

An Ice Mirror has 10 Hit Points, 20 AC, Resistance to Piercing, Slashing, Cold and Wind Damage, and vulnerable to fire damage and lasts for up to 1 minute. You can maintain up to 2 Ice Mirrors at once, creating an additional Ice Mirrors beyond the limit melts the oldest one. The number of Ice Mirrors you can maintain increases by +1 at 7th, 11th and 15th levels.

While you have at least one Ice Mirrors active, you gain the following abilities;

Join Reflection. By spending 5 feet of movement, while adjacent to an Ice Mirror, you can infuse yourself into it. While infused in this way, you occupy the same space as the glass and your reflection is shown on all active Ice Mirrors. While occupying an Ice Mirror, you can spend 5 feet of movement to exit the Ice Mirror you are occupying, moving into a space that can hold you within 5 feet. If the mirrors HP is reduced to 0 while you are occupying it, remaining damage is applied to you and you exit the destroyed mirror, occupying the space it previously occupied.

Attacking Reflections. When you infuse into a Ice Mirror, while at least one other Ice Mirrors is active, you can make a Stealth check with a rank of Mastery. On a success, gain the benefits of a successful Hide action as creatures cannot tell which mirror you are currently occupying until a creature succeeds a Search.

Mirrors Protection. If you are occupying a glass, all attacks targeting you, instead target the Ice Mirrors. While infused into a glass, you have immunity to the Grappled, Restrained and Prone conditions and cannot be moved against your will, except by teleportation.

Reflective Movement. By spending 10 feet of movement, while occupying a Ice Mirrors, you can teleport into another Ice Mirrors within 30 feet of the current Ice Mirrors you are occupying.

Mirrored Strike. While occupying a Ice Mirrors, when you make a ranged attack, this does not end your successful stealth benefit, if any.

Bloody Mist Legacy

3rd Level Clan Feature

Your clans previous near extinction has taught all of the clans survivors one major lesson. To never outshine your masters. The Clan has learned to adapt from its bloody legacy. Its clansmen adapt to their surroundings more, but never commit and always be ready to pack up and move to survive, if necessary.

When you gain this feature, select 1 path. You can switch this paths by spending a Bonus Action. Though, as a quirk of your clans need to never try the same thing twice too soon to avoid suspicion, you cannot select paths you previously selected, until you spend at least 10 minutes outside of combat.

If an ability requires a saving throw or attack, use your highest jutsu save DC or attack bonus.

Refraction

Double Pane: When you create an Ice Mirror, you instead create 2, instead of 1 and your mirrors have immunity to Poison Damage.

Truth in Passing: You gain a rank of Mastery to Investigation. This increases to two ranks at 11th level. When you take the Study action, you can complete it as an Action, instead of 1 minute.

Frostbane: When you inflict the Frostbite condition on a creature within 10 feet of an Ice Mirror, you can force the affected creature to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they are dragged into the Ice Mirrors, and then expelled from another active Ice Mirrors, falling prone into a space within 5 feet of the Ice Mirrors they were expelled from.

Hoarfrost

Frosted Glass: While occupying an Ice Mirror, all Ice Mirrors, emit a mist, filling a 10-foot radius around them. Allied creatures standing within this mist gain the benefit of Mirrors Protection.

Ominous Reflections: You gain a rank of Mastery to Chakra Control. This increases to two ranks at 11th level. When you take the Suppress Chakra action, you can select an active Ice Mirrors. That Ice Mirrors now emits chakra, making it look like you are occupying it, even if you aren’t.

Brine Prison: When you inflict the Frostbite condition on a creature, that creature releases a pulse of frozen air, freezing the ground around them, making it slippery. The affected creature turns a 10-foot radius, centered on them into difficult terrain for the next minute. You have immunity to this difficult terrain and if an effect that deals fire damage would occur or overlap with the affected area, the difficult terrain is dispelled.

Glacial Movement

Glacial Jump: Once per turn, when you use Reflective Movement to teleport to an Ice Mirror, it costs you no movement. Additionally, You can use the effects of Mirrored Strike, to make melee attacks, against creatures up to 15 feet away from your Ice Mirrors as if they were within your melee attacks range.

Hostile Terrain: You gain a rank of Mastery to Initiative. This increases to two ranks at 11th level. When you create difficult terrain with a Hijutsu you cast or feature you use, hostile creatures take 5 cold damage for each space they pass through and allied creatures are immune to the effects of the difficult terrain.

Rime Line: When you move, you leave behind a layer of rime on the surface you are moving on and all adjacent surfaces. This rime melts at the beginning of your next turn.

Black Ice Mirror

Black Iron Reflection: Your Ice Mirrors gains 5 DR against damage it isn’t Immune, Resistant or Vulnerable to.

Frost Courier: You gain a rank of Mastery to Athletics. This increases to two ranks at 11th level. Allied creatures that take damage while within 10 feet of an Ice Mirrors, can spend their reaction to fall back into the Ice Mirrors, and teleporting into a space within 5 feet of another Ice Mirrors as if they jumped into one and exited from another.

Black Frost: When a hostile creature destroys an Ice Mirrors you are occupying, the mirror explodes, forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw, becoming Frost Bitten on a failure.

Shiver-Weave

Invisible Threads: When you teleport between Ice Mirrors, using Reflective Movement, you can draw a line between the mirrors you teleported between, that only you can see, that lasts until the beginning of your next turn. If a hostile creature moves through this invisible line, you can spend your Reaction, to teleport to a previously occupied mirror and perform a number of attacks equal to the number of active Ice Mirrors against the triggering creature, dealing 2d6 + Modifier in cold damage, for each successful attack, and forcing them to make a Dexterity saving throw, having their speed reduced to 0 until the end of the current turn, on a failure.

Hail Burst: You gain a rank of Mastery to Stealth. This increases to two ranks at 11th level. As part of casting a Yuki Hijutsu, you can release a cloud of snowy hail from your body filling a 15-foot cube, originating from you. This cloud totally obscures creatures within and on opposite sides of it, but vanishes at the beginning of your next turn.

Frost Splinter: When a creature destroys an Ice Mirror, you can spend your Reaction, to teleport to another active Ice Mirrors. You still take any damage that would be inflicted.

Frost bound Shield

Bulwark: Ice Mirrors that you summon gains additional hit points equal to your level.

Stalwart: You gain a rank of Mastery to Strength and Dexterity saving throws while occupying an Ice Mirror. This increases to two ranks at 11th level. Additionally, Ice Mirrors you summon are resistant to damage that affects an area.

Black Frost: When you inflict the Frostbite condition, all of your active Ice Mirrors regain 5 hit point.

Ice Release Manifestation

| Frostbite / Max Ranks: 5, [Elemental] / A Frostbitten creature suffers the effects of extreme cold. / A Frostbitten creature takes 1d10 cold damage at the end of their for each rank they have, if they have not spent at least half of their movement moving into a new space before the end of their turns. / A Frostbitten creature cannot cast jutsu with the Combo keyword, or benefit from a jutsu’s Chain 2 or 3 effects. / Creatures that are immune to Cold damage is immune to this condition. / A Frostbitten creature can spend an Action to make a DC 20 Dexterity ability check to end this affliction. On a successful check, the condition ends. |

7th Level Clan Feature

The Yuki clan has a unique talent for manifesting Ice Release due to their close affinity to both Wind and Water Release. You gain the second Nature release you didn’t select from Ice Release Affinity clan trait and when casting a jutsu with either Wind or Water release keywords, you can change the damage type to Wind or Cold respectively.

Your skills with Ice Mirrors you create has become far more prominent, garnering you the following benefits;

Ice Mirrors that you occupy can use its own AC or your AC, whichever is higher.

While not in combat, you can allow allied creatures to teleport through your Ice Mirrors through to another Ice Mirrors.

When you summon an Ice Mirror, you can have it suspended in the air, no higher than 10 feet off the ground.

Sanctum of Ice

11th Level Clan Feature

You were born of the snow and ice. It comforts you, and you find some solace in its inclusion in the environment around you. When you begin your turn within 30 feet of a creature with ranks of Chilled or Frostbite, you can reduce that creatures rank of the listed condition by up to 5. When you do, you regain hit points equal to 10 times the ranks removed.

Additionally, when you would end your turn with ranks of an Elemental condition, while another creature has ranks of Chilled or Frostbite, you can reduce that creatures rank of the listed condition by up to 5. When you do, you reduce the ranks of the Elemental condition you have by an equal amount.

Once you use either effect you cannot do so again until the end of your next turn.

Demonic Mirror Master

15th Level Clan Feature

You are what the Yuki clan has worked so hard to achieve. You have become the culmination of decades of training and technique.

As a bonus Action, on your turn, you enter a state of perfection, like that of an unmalting snowflake, called the Demonic Ice Prism (or Prism, for short), that lasts for 1 minute. Once you exit this state, you cannot enter it again until you complete a rest. While in this state you gain the following benefits;

Select up to 8 Spaces you can see within 60 feet of you, that is unoccupied. You summon an Ice Mirror in each chosen space. You then immediately occupy the closest Ice Mirrors to you, teleporting into its space. Ice Mirrors created this way do not count against the limit of Ice Mirrors you can create.

Once per turn, at the beginning of your turn, you can switch which paths from the Bloody Mist Legacy clan feature you benefit from. Switching paths in this way does not prevent you from switching back for the duration.

When you cast the Ice Daggers Hijutsu, compare the attack result vs the AC of all creatures of your choice within 15 feet of an active Ice Mirrors.
